I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I confirmed that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, which replaces the number they posted in #north-team this morning. I also said I won't take any other action, since they asked for none.

A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to say it in that channel.
